items.q: What makes Arabian Village olive oil different?
items.a: It is pure Palestinian olive oil, cold-pressed and unprocessed using traditional methods passed down through generations, from tree to bottle.
Yes. Arabian Village olive oil is cold-pressed and unprocessed to preserve its natural quality and flavour.

items.q: How should I use it daily?
items.a: Arabian Village promotes a simple 60-second daily ritual of taking the olive oil as part of a natural daily wellness routine.

items.q: Where do the olives come from?
items.a: The olives are sourced from Palestine and pressed using traditional methods carried through generations.

items.q: Do you offer wholesale or business options?
items.a: Yes. Arabian Village offers both a personal ritual option for individuals and a business/wholesale option for retailers and partners.

items.q: Where can I buy Arabian Village olive oil?
items.a: Arabian Village olive oil is available directly through this site, with retail and wholesale options, and through retail partners such as Berkat Madinah Store in Malaysia.
